title: Certify every combination using one acquired common error region
statement: Let C_r be the event that all guards through the stopped cohort match. With fixed candidates and fresh q guards per adaptively selected source, Pr[C_r AND sum_i e_i>eta]<=exp(-q*eta). On C_r outside that bad event, the common error union has mass<=eta and all actual/program linear combinations agree outside it simultaneously. Rejected cohorts receive no certificate. This is a joint bad-acceptance bound, not conditional-on-acceptance accuracy without a yield bound.

requires: Fixed source/candidate during its own fresh independent guards, bounded cohort stopping and paid summably budgeted restarts.
Issue a zero-failure cohort certificate only on C_r, the event that all guards through the stopped cohort match; any mismatch rejects the cohort.

assumptions: A mismatch cannot be dropped followed by an unbudgeted restart. Joint-event acceptance bounds do not give conditional-on-return accuracy without yield. Finite-field equality supports the common-region combination argument; small real-valued errors do not.
costs: Zero-failure guards cost r*q values with q>=ln(1/delta)/eta; tolerant guards use q>=12*ln(1/min(delta,zeta0))/eta per source. Near-family transfer costs r(D+1)L with odd L>=32*ln(r/zeta)/9, plus fresh target guards. Language dimension M=binom(n+D,D), pivot search up to M*r known evaluations, inversion O(r^3), target solve O(r^2), code evaluation, field bit arithmetic, sampling/rejection caps, failed cohorts and fits all remain paid. r versus M is not total-runtime superiority.
contract.units: Finite-field outputs use log2(p) bits; eta,tau,beta and risks are dimensionless disagreement probabilities under the declared native law. r,M,D,L,q count dimensions/degrees/directions/actual values, not equal-cost hardware operations.
contract.obstruction: Acquire a useful language and related future tasks with actual return power and full amortized costs. Longer interactive use needs deterministic finite-horizon input-domination/risk caps. No physical learning system, new primitive priority or universal scientific discovery capability is established.

body: Let B=C_r AND sum_i e_i>eta. For source risk e_i, Z_i=1(C_i)*exp(q*sum_{j<=i}e_j) is a nonnegative supermartingale under fresh guards. Bounded stopping and Markov give Pr[B]<=exp(-q*eta). Only on C_r outside B does sum_i e_i<=eta, so the union E of actual disagreement sets has mass<=eta. Outside the same E every f_i equals G_i, hence every finite-field linear combination agrees simultaneously, including coefficients chosen after the full history. On rejection no certificate is issued. The bound is joint bad acceptance; a conditional-on-acceptance error bound needs a separate positive yield bound. The tolerant accepted event has its own stated joint soundness/power bounds. This v2 corrects only the extraction acceptance condition; v1 and its historical review remain recoverable. The v1 complement wording also included rejected runs: for one source f=0 and fixed candidate G=1 with 0<eta<1, every guard fails, the bad-acceptance event is false and its complement holds, but disagreement mass is1>eta. This refutes the extraction, not the governing source theorem.
